articles.title: Hong Kong bond markets, yuan issuance to expand in 2026 under HKMA, SFC road map
articles.mainIdea: Hong Kong bond markets, yuan issuance to expand in 2026 under HKMA, SFC road map
articles.summary: South China Morning Post: Hong Kong bond markets, yuan issuance to expand in 2026 under HKMA, SFC road map. Hong Kong is expected to see a rise in bond issuance across multiple currencies in 2026, driven by rising demand for non-US dollar assets amid geopolitical tensions and government initiatives to strengthen the city's capital markets, according to industry players.
